About PATIDARRANG College
Patidarrang college is the premier institute of Higher Education
                            imparting education up to under graduate level in Nasatra near Muktapur,Kamrup (R) district
                            of Assam . It was established on the 31st day of August,1989 by a team of selfless and
                            untiring social workers and think-tank of the greater locality with the aim to make higher
                            education accessible to students of marginalized section of this locality. Late Santapal Das
                            and Late Jogendra Nath Kumar were the first President and the Secretary of the Governing
                            Body of the college respectively. Since its beginning at a room in Patidarrang Vidyapith
                            High Sc hool in the kamrup district of Assam the college has grown into a leading higher
                            educational institution with its own campus and infrastructure to accommodate around 1200
                            students in undergraduate level in Arts Stream.
The eastern part of kamrup district is known as Patidarrang the
                            mention of which is found in the Thesis “ Assam: its formation and development” of Dr. Bani
                            Kanta Kakati. Patidarrang area encompasses the greater eastern part of Kamrup district. This
                            area is constituted including 6 Mauza i.e. Barbanshar, Madartola, Pub-Kasari Mahal,
                            Patidarrang, Karara, Betna. The College is situated in Nasatra near Muktapur under
                            Patidarrang Mauza. There are 5 Panchyat under Patidarrang Mauza namely Balahati, Bardangeri
                            Kuchi, Jatya Bhangara, Loch and Muktapur which has 30 –villages under it.

Principal Desk
Dr. Biswajit Kalita
It gives me immense pleasure to welcome you to Patidarrang College, a premier institution of higher education located at Nasatra, Muktapur in the district of Kamrup (Rural), Assam. Since its establishment on 31st August 1989, the college has remained steadfast in its commitment to providing quality higher education, particularly to students from socially and economically disadvantaged backgrounds.
Founded through the dedicated efforts of visionary educationists and socially committed individuals, the college has evolved from humble beginnings into a vibrant centre of learning. Today, it stands with its own campus and essential infrastructure, catering to undergraduate education in the Arts stream.
At Patidarrang College, we believe that education transcends the mere acquisition of knowledge; it is a transformative process that shapes character, instills values, and equips individuals to face life's challenges with confidence and integrity. Our mission is to nurture young minds by fostering intellectual curiosity, moral strength, and a deep sense of social responsibility.
In an era marked by rapid change and growing complexities, the role of education has become increasingly dynamic. We strive to create a holistic learning environment that promotes academic excellence alongside co-curricular and cultural development. Our dedicated faculty members work with commitment and care to help students discover their potential and develop the skills necessary to become competent, responsible, and enlightened citizens.
